t.LIMONENE.agn: A fragrance allergen in the EU: it must be named in the ingredient list above 0.001% in leave-on and 0.01% in rinse-off products (Annex III, entry 88). The substance's peroxide value must be below 20 mmol/L.
t.LIMONENE.eff.0: May cause skin reactions in people with fragrance allergy; this is why the EU requires it to be named on the label above a set level.
t.LIMONENE.reg.0: EU Cosmetics Regulation Annex III, entry 88: fragrance allergen; must be named in the ingredient list above a set level.
t.LIMONENE.summary: The main scent compound of citrus peel; a fragrance allergen.
t.LIMONENE.what: Gives the product a citrus scent; also used as a solvent.
